summary: After one year in Washington, wide receiver Deebo Samuel has returned to San Francisco. And 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk couldn't be happier about that. Juszczyk, who was in San Francisco for all six of Samuel's seasons on the 49ers, said that Samuel was a great teammate in the past and is already showing that he's a great teammate again.

title: UFC's Nascimento, 34, dies after apparent heart attack
excerpt: MMA fighter Allan Nascimento dies at the age of 34, says the sport's leading promotion the UFC.
summary: Allan Nascimento had six fights in five years with the UFC [Getty Images] Mixed martial arts fighter Allan Nascimento has died at the age of 34, says the UFC. "Despite the efforts of the responding medical team, he was pronounced deceased at the scene," added a UFC statement.

The narrative centers on Masekela’s decision to collaborate with Miriam Makeba on the Graceland band, a move that put him at odds with anti-apartheid advocates who viewed Simon’s album as a violation of the UN’s cultural boycott.
